questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

19 * 5 * 5 * 220 * 2 * 10
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 19 * 5 * 5 * 220 * 2 * 10

(1) **=, ÷, ×, +, −**

⇒ 19 * 5 * 5 * 220 * 2 * 10

After putting the signs:

⇒ 19 = __**5 ÷ 5**__ × 220 + 2 - 10

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 19 = __**1 **____**× 220**__ + 2 - 10

⇒ 19 = 220 + 2 - 10

⇒ 19 = 222 - 10

⇒ 19 = 212

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **×, +, =, ÷, −**

⇒ 19 * 5 * 5 * 220 * 2 * 10

After putting the signs:

⇒ __**19 × 5**__ + 5 = __**220 ÷ 2**__ - 10

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 95 + 5 = 110 - 10

⇒ 100 = 100

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3)** ****+, −, =, ×, ÷**

⇒ 19 * 5 * 5 * 220 * 2 * 10

After putting the signs:

⇒ 19 + 5 - 5 = 220 × __**2 ÷ 10**__

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 19 + 5 - 5 = __**220 × 0.2**__

⇒ 24 - 5 = 44

⇒ 19 = 44

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) **–, +, ×, ÷, =**

⇒ 19 * 5 * 5 * 220 * 2 * 10

After putting the signs:

⇒ 19 - 5 + 5 × __**220 ÷ 2**__ = 10

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 19 - 5 + __**5 × 110**__

⇒ 19 - 5 + 550

⇒ 569 - 5 = 564

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**×, +, =, ÷, −**".

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

(1) **– and +**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**108 ÷ 27**__ × 54 + 40 - 34

⇒ __**4 × 54**__ + 40 - 34

⇒ 216 + 40 - 34

⇒ 256 - 34 = 222

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(2) **÷ and ×**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 108 × __**27 ÷ 54 **__– 40 + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ __**108 × 0.5**__ - 40 + 34

⇒ 54 - 40 + 34

⇒ 88 - 40 = **48**

⇒ LHS = RHS

⇒ '108 × 27 ÷ 54 – 40 + 34 = 48'

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(3) **× and –**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ __**108 ÷ 27**__ × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 - 54 × 40 + 34

⇒ 4 - 54 × 40 + 34

⇒ 4 - 2160 + 34

⇒ 38 - 2160 = (-2122)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) **÷ and –**

⇒ 108 ÷ 27 × 54 – 40 + 34 = 48

After interchanging the signs:

⇒ 108 - 27 × __**54 ÷ 40**__ + 34 = 48

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 108 - 27 × 1.35 + 34

⇒ 108 - 36.45 + 34

⇒ 142 - 36.45 = 105.55

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**÷ and ×**".

questions.question:
‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’

Which of the following options means 'R is the sister of P'?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d1b1b5ceb1a343ec2e3f5a062e9395feb2a5a25c7f9fdfa7177c10694aa65ab.png] 

As per the given data:

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
#

 
 
 

 
 
**Means**

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 

 
 
of B

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

Checking all the given options:

**1. R @ S @ Q # P**

R is the son of S, S is the son of Q and Q is the daughter of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd2c5cae9a23e7adb0c7da716874a2a79d4aca3de1364ac578af9d0022c80726.png] 

Here, R is the grandson of P's daughter.

**2. P # Q @ R # S**

P is the daughter of Q, Q is the son of R and R is the daughter S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5447706fea56b444150df2f882d8eb5a26f9ac8d3eeb182df53072c76a12f834.png] 

Here, R is the grandmother of P.

**3. R @ S & Q # P**

R is the son of S, S is the mother of Q and Q is the daughter of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/563514ab55abafd8384fa909f697f3ef773e9b3e2a544f5d0668ce8bd38f2b72.png] 

Here, R is the son of P.

**4. P @ Q & R # S**

P is the son of Q, Q is the mother of R and R is the daughter of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66219e8f8757102f98d0e441eed61f234e15addc1f8067c0ec1858c4f44f7fbb.png] 

Here, R is the** sister** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "**P @ Q & R # S".**
